goal: Produce a Markdown report (saved to disk, absolute path returned) that cross-tabulates offline_data/students.csv by grade (G10/G11/G12) × region (A/B/C/D), reports row count and reading_score mean per cell, identifies the highest- and lowest-mean cells with their sample sizes, annotates every key number with its source, and ends with a conclusion — using only the local CSV, no web data.

plan.title: Analyze students.csv and write Markdown report: Read offline_data/students.csv; group by (grade, region) for G10/G11/G12 × A/B/C/D; compute row count and mean(reading_score) per cell; identify the cell with the highest and lowest mean and note its sample size; write a Markdown report to disk containing: a level-1 title, at least one data table of all 12 cells (count + mean), inline source annotations in the exact format '（来源：offline_data/students.csv 的 reading_score，按 grade×region 分组，样本行数 N）' for every key number and '（来源：由前述两行计算）' for any derived ratio, and a closing conclusion paragraph; save the file and return its absolute path. All conclusions must come solely from this local CSV — no network access.
